description.zh: 请求体参数。用来指定待创建采集器的配置信息。
description.en: The request body parameters. Used to specify the configuration information of the collector to create.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch create-collector --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --dry-run false --name test_beats_1 --res-type fileBeat --vpc-id vpc-bp12nu14urf0upaf00000 --res-version 6.8.5_with_community --collector-paths /var/log --configs fileName=filebeat.yml content=filebeat.inputs:xxx --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
